description: This Java class 'EventReporter' is responsible for reporting virtual device boot status and other related messages to the console and kernel log. It manages writing messages to /dev/kmsg, logs events such as boot start, completion, failure, and screen changes, and maintains a list of reported messages.

classes.name: EventReporter
classes.description: A class that reports virtual device boot events and status messages to kernel log and maintains a message history.

methods.name: EventReporter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes log output streams.

methods.name: onDependencyFailed
methods.description: Reports a boot failure with an exception message.

methods.name: onDependencyStraggling
methods.description: Reports that boot is pending due to ongoing dependencies.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Marks boot as completed after a delay, logs the event.

methods.name: reportMessage
methods.description: Logs a message to logcat, kernel message buffer, and stores it in message list.

methods.name: reportBootStarted
methods.description: Reports that the virtual device boot has started.

methods.name: reportScreenChanged
methods.description: Reports a change in screen parameters.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Returns the list of all reported messages so far.
